verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server, a hosted URL that works with any MCP-compatible tool, and an official Claude connector. This covers the core agent-access story with no glue code. However, the evidence never says which tools the server exposes (search, transcripts, action items), and the auth step is only described as "authenticate" rather than explicitly OAuth. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list covering meeting search, transcripts and action items; explicit OAuth flow for the MCP connection; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude
claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
